notes_for_editor: Thin: one list entry (tnlandforms GA127) with county, coordinates, an elevation value the page gives no unit for (the record's 103.6 m assumes feet), BLL 64707 and gfc 516. The page's notes do explain the codes: BLL-nnn marks the 118 towers whose coordinates GFC provided, and gfc-nnn marks towers from an older GFC list of 203. The story now uses that wording instead of calling them register references. GFC is not spelled out on the page. The cited Georgia page does not name Tom Dunigan, so the story and footnote omit him. I read the full 29-name NHLR Georgia list; Ocilla is not on it. No build, staffing, fate or site description found in two searches and the register pages. Do not confuse with the tnlandforms entry 'adams' in Irwin County at 31.68602, -83.38340 (GA227), a different tower; see us-ga-adams. Lead for a human: the Georgia Forestry Commission Irwin County unit in Ocilla (a directory listing, not read). Story is about 134 words.
